# langsmith_agent (Data Source)

Looks up a workspace-scoped LangSmith agent and its environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_agent" "support" {
  agent_id = "support-agent"
}

data "langsmith_agent" "development" {
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  agent_id     = "development-agent"
}

output "production_environment_id" {
  value = data.langsmith_agent.support.environments["PRODUCTION"].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Workspace-unique agent identifier.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace (tenant) ID. Defaults to the provider workspace.

### Read-Only

- `agent_type` (String) Agent type.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `environments` (Attributes Map) Agent environments keyed by environment name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `id` (String) Agent identifier (same as agent_id).
- `name` (String) Agent display name.
- `source_type` (String) Agent source type.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Agent environment UUID.
- `tracer_session_id` (String) Tracing project UUID.
- `tracer_session_name` (String) Tracing project name.
